profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Finalsite
profile.summary:
I am a creative person who is passionate about technology and development.

When it comes to the web, I love to create unique, beautiful and efficient pages. My work is set apart by my attention to detail and my desire to provide my clients with exactly what they want.

I'm highly skilled in technologies such as Java, SQL and more.

I've used Spring to make even more efficient Java applications, and have experience with AWS too.

I primarily use GitHub to host my applications.  I have experience on Mac, Linux, and Windows; however I have the most experience with Mac.

projects.title: Briefcase
projects.description:
● Allows for storage of jobs a user has applied to. The app stores the date of the application submission, the position's salary, the contacts the user has spoken with about the job, and any other useful notes about the position.
● Lead tester
● Project coordinator/lead host

projects.title: BeerHop
projects.description:
● Allows user to locate local breweries in any location they choose. Users may also search for local news articles or post anonymous comments.
● Lead Designer in a group of 4, used HTML, CSS, JQuery
● Other technologies used: Google Maps API, Bootstrap
